title: SQLite 3.22.0 cross-built for CheriBSD purecap, the engine corpus's third and fourth arms
workload: the 33 cases of sqlite/engine-repros, plus poscontrol.c, which must fault or the run is void

arms.cheribsd-revocation: memsys5 on a 256 KiB static arena, the same allocator the Capstone arms use. Built by build-corpus-cheri.sh and run by run-corpus-cheri.sh.

note: The cases/ here are deliberately not the same files as repro322/: CheriBSD has a real VFS, so a case that needs a database file opens one instead of embedding it, and the probe instrumentation differs. tags.tsv in repro322/ maps every runner tag to its case or says why it is not one, and both the build and the runner take their list from it rather than from `ls out/`.
